# arubasdwan_vrrp_instances (Data Source)

Fetches the VRRP instances configured on the appliances from the Aruba SD-WAN Orchestrator: per appliance the group ID, peering interface, virtual IP address, priority, preemption, and timers, plus the operational state (Master/Backup/Init, current master IP, transitions, uptime, virtual MAC). Appliances without VRRP configuration are included with an empty instance list.

The data is combined from these Orchestrator endpoints:

- `GET /gms/rest/appliance` — appliance inventory (hostname, serial, model, site)
- `GET /gms/rest/vrrp` — VRRP instances per appliance

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the VRRP instances of all appliances
data "arubasdwan_vrrp_instances" "all" {}

# VRRP overview per appliance: interface, group, virtual IP, and state
output "vrrp" {
  value = {
    for a in data.arubasdwan_vrrp_instances.all.appliances :
    a.hostname => [
      for v in a.vrrp_instances : {
        interface  = v.interface
        group_id   = v.group_id
        virtual_ip = v.virtual_ip
        priority   = v.priority
        state      = v.state
      }
    ] if length(a.vrrp_instances) > 0
  }
}

# All virtual IP addresses in use, e.g. for documentation exports (FHRP/VRRP
# groups in an IPAM/DCIM system such as NetBox)
output "virtual_ips" {
  value = distinct(flatten([
    for a in data.arubasdwan_vrrp_instances.all.appliances : [
      for v in a.vrrp_instances : v.virtual_ip
    ]
  ]))
}

# Read a single appliance by its Orchestrator primary key
data "arubasdwan_vrrp_instances" "branch01" {
  ne_pk = "3.NE"
}

# Server-side filtering: exclude lab systems, restrict to one site.
# Filtered appliances are never queried.
data "arubasdwan_vrrp_instances" "filtered" {
  exclude_hostname_regex = "(?i)^(lab|test)-"
  sites                  = ["Berlin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cached` (Boolean) Whether to read VRRP data from the Orchestrator database (true, default) or live from each appliance (false). Live reads are slower and fail for unreachable appliances.
- `exclude_hostname_regex` (String) Exclude appliances whose hostname matches this RE2 regular expression (e.g. "(?i)^(lab|test)-").
- `exclude_models` (List of String) Exclude appliances whose model is in this list (case-insensitive exact match, e.g. ["EC-V"]).
- `exclude_sites` (List of String) Exclude appliances whose site is in this list (case-insensitive exact match).
- `hostname_regex` (String) Only include appliances whose hostname matches this RE2 regular expression (e.g. "^br-" or "(?i)^(ber|ham)-").
- `models` (List of String) Only include appliances whose model is in this list (case-insensitive exact match, e.g. ["EC-S-B"]). Filters apply before any per-appliance data is fetched.
- `ne_pk` (String) Optional appliance primary key (e.g. "3.NE") to fetch a single appliance. If omitted, all appliances are returned.
- `sites` (List of String) Only include appliances whose site is in this list (case-insensitive exact match).

All filters are combined with AND and applied before any per-appliance data is fetched, so excluded appliances are never queried.

### Read-Only

- `appliances` (Attributes List) List of appliances with their VRRP instances, sorted by hostname. Appliances without VRRP configuration carry an empty vrrp_instances list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appliances))

<a id="nestedatt--appliances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appliances`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the appliance.
- `model` (String) Appliance model (e.g. "EC-S-B").
- `ne_pk` (String) Orchestrator primary key of the appliance (e.g. "3.NE").
- `serial` (String) Hardware serial number of the appliance.
- `site` (String) Site name the appliance is tagged with in the Orchestrator.
- `vrrp_instances` (Attributes List) VRRP instances configured on the appliance, sorted by interface and group ID; empty if none are configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appliances--vrrp_instances))

<a id="nestedatt--appliances--vrrp_instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appliances.vrrp_instances`

Read-Only:

- `advertisement_timer` (Number) Time interval between VRRP advertisements in seconds.
- `auth` (String, Sensitive) VRRP authentication string; may be empty or masked by the Orchestrator.
- `description` (String) Description string of the VRRP instance.
- `enabled` (Boolean) True if the VRRP instance is administratively up.
- `group_id` (Number) VRRP group ID (VRID) shared by the two peers of the group (1-255).
- `holddown` (Number) Holddown timer in seconds.
- `interface` (String) Interface the VRRP instance is peering on (e.g. "lan0").
- `master_ip` (String) Interface or local IP address of the current VRRP master.
- `master_transitions` (Number) Number of Master/Backup transitions of the instance; a high number indicates a problematic VRRP configuration or environment.
- `packet_trace` (Boolean) True if VRRP packet tracing is enabled on the instance.
- `preempt` (Boolean) True if the higher-priority peer takes over the master role again when it comes back online.
- `priority` (Number) VRRP priority (1-254); the peer with the higher priority is the VRRP master.
- `state` (String) Operational state of the instance: "Master", "Backup", or "Init" (initializing, disabled, or interface down).
- `uptime` (String) Time elapsed since the instance entered its current state (e.g. "0 days 11 hrs 49 mins 41 secs").
- `virtual_ip` (String) Virtual IP address of the VRRP group.
- `virtual_mac` (String) MAC address the VRRP instance is using (00-00-5E-00-01-{VRID} on hardware appliances, the interface MAC on virtual appliances).
- `vip_owner` (Boolean) True if the appliance owns the virtual IP address; always false on EdgeConnect appliances, which cannot use one of their own IP addresses as the VRRP IP.
